N1.risk_note: Only fine plus screen reaches the silent cells; Qwen's placebo shows the authority text alone may drive any change, so report a placebo-style caveat.

N2.risk_note: Unannounced screen may produce penalties and learning dynamics that need careful interpretation; Sonnet cells are costly, so pair one Sonnet cell with Haiku cells.

N3.risk_note: A pass adds little; a fail further weakens the fine results without a new insight.

N4.risk_note: Formation under leniency is about 0.02, so even 8 more pools add only a handful of cartels.

N5.risk_note: Evasion results are dual-use; report rates and patterns, not prompts that work, and frame as a red-team of the authority's instrument.

why: The focal-threshold effect is the paper's most original assurance finding; testing it causally (N2) and against an adaptive adversary (N5) turns an observation into a robustness result, N1 cheaply extends it across families.
missing_run: Screen false-positive rate measured on non-colluding LLM agents (for example the certain-detection or rematch-every-period arm plus screen) instead of scripted players.
